precepts.text: Be not ignorant of anything in a great matter or a small. You got to understand things in great matters as well as small. Do not be ignorant in the functionings of this body.
precepts.point: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost. By him actions are weighed. Somebody speaking of Christ and calling him accursed, that is not of the Lord; somebody who confessed Christ is Lord, this person believes.
precepts.why:
Paul opens, “Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.” Sirach says the same: “Be not ignorant of any thing in a great matter or a small.” You have to learn this and understand it, in the great matters as well as the small.

Do not be ignorant in the functionings of this body. It is essential to understand how the body works: you have to realize what every individual is worth. Nobody is above this. You are special because you are part of the body, but do not think you are more than another part. We are all one, working towards the same goal, and we have to do exactly what the Lord told us to do to get where we need to get.

It is easy to come in, sit down, and think everybody is just doing what they do. But understand how intricate this thing is, how many different offices there are in this body. Some came in, got patted down, dropped the kids off, and did not think twice about how much goes into dealing with those children. Some will get a plate of food brought to them and have no idea how many hands were involved to make that plate possible. There are people with gifts to deal with things you do not even have to think about. Be not ignorant of that.

precepts.text: If thou hast understanding, answer thy neighbour; if not, lay thy hand upon thy mouth. When you do not know, shut up. Do not freestyle; speak truth to your neighbour. You can look composed and unbothered and still not know what you are talking about.
precepts.point: As it is written is where we live. When someone asks why I have one wife, I take them to the scripture where the Lord said one wife, no remix, no loophole.

note.label: Fixx Ya Face Fridays | as Was Supposed!!

precepts.why:
“Let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written”. As it is written is where we stay and where we live, and we are not budging from it. Whenever we say something God said, we go back to the scripture and justify ourselves with thus saith the Lord. If you do it any other way, you are evil.

Sirach shows what to do when you do not have the scripture for it: “If thou hast understanding, answer thy neighbour; if not, lay thy hand upon thy mouth.” When you are asked a question and you understand, and you know where in the Bible it is, give answer. If you do not know, shut up. That is what laying your hand upon your mouth means. It is best to be quiet.

You do not get to freestyle or go off the top of your head. You have to speak truth to your neighbour; that is the law. I don’t care how composed you look or how unbothered you make yourself appear; if you don’t know what you’re talking about, shut up. Pride steps in, and brothers get frazzled but will not let you know it.

That is what happened with Luke 3:23, “being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli”. Someone did not know, so he made up that Jacob and Heli were brothers and pulled in levirate marriage, when the “as was supposed” was about Christ being the son of Joseph and had nothing to do with Heli. Lay Luke 3 beside Matthew 1 and they are two different lineages: Matthew follows Joseph, Luke follows Mary. Nowhere does the Bible say Jacob and Heli were brothers. Let God be true and keep it as it is written; where you have no scripture, lay your hand upon your mouth.

precepts.why: “Say not, I have enough for my life.” Then: “Follow not thine own mind and thy strength, to walk in the ways of thy heart”. That’s what you don’t do when you go through a trial. People going through a trial end up in their head, always in their own mind. Over time you overthink things, or you don’t think at all and you’re just emotional, leaning one way or the other, because you’re not talking to nobody.

note.label: Escape New Years | Armageddon: Chain Of Events

precepts.why:
“Be stedfast in thy understanding”: be steadfast in what you’ve learned. “And let thy word be the same”: let your words be the same, coming out of the Bible. “Be swift to hear”: in your own head you ain’t listening; you’re listening to somebody, but it ain’t coming from here. “And let thy life be sincere”: be honest with yourself. Am I right in this? All the witnesses say no; three, four counsellor brothers are saying bro, you’re going off, and you’re like nah, you guys are wrong. You’re straying alone.

“And with patience give answer.” The less you talk the better; the more you talk, the more you end yourself. Sometimes it’s best just to listen, take heed, listen with patience. You got to learn to use discretion.

There's no time. “Say not, I have sinned, and what harm hath happened unto me? for the Lord is longsuffering, he will in no wise let thee go. Concerning propitiation, be not without fear to add sin unto sin: And say not His mercy is great; he will be pacified for the multitude of my sins.”

That is the last thing you should be saying: the Lord will be cool, he isn't worried about that, the Lord knows my heart, I don't normally do things like this. We point to the men in the Bible who messed up, King David, King Solomon. You aren't David, and you aren't Solomon, and you might not be here much longer if you keep thinking like that, acting like you'll be around forever and will never get caught. When the husband comes home and catches them, nobody feels bad for either of them; both consented, and whatever happens after the fact, even the law understands it.

points: Concerning propitiation, be not without fear to add sin unto sin. You saw how it escalated: from claiming the money as hers, to her sister lying for her, to her lying again about bringing it to the counter. Sin unto sin. And say not, his mercy is great, he will be pacified for the multitude of my sins: that is what a Christian would say. But without repenting, how would you receive mercy? You have to confess, then repent. For mercy and wrath come from him: Christians say he is merciful but forget the wrath. He is a God of love, but he is also a God of judgment; the Lord loves judgment. You want to be found among the judges, not among the judged.

note.label: Making Our Face Harder Than Their Face

points: Be not ignorant of any thing in a great matter or a small. Know a little about everything, not as a professional, so nobody can lie to you and you are not fooled by social media. A man is supposed to know what is going on; you check the weather for tomorrow, so check the news for ten or fifteen minutes.
Get news from videos that just came out, not from the regular news that lies. The war has been going three weeks and some of you have no clue because you live in la-la land.
Be stedfast in thine understanding: do not let your family sway you back into Christianity, and know that the Lord woke you up for a reason.

Let thy word be the same — do not be a hypocrite. You cannot spend January to November trying to get your people to repent and then in November say you will just take one bowl of chitlins home, or accept just one Christmas gift. They laugh at you for it.

note.label: Black Christians Stuck in Delusional Orbiting Cycles of Stupidity

points: So understand, there's no man or woman on the face of the planet that has not sinned. So don't say that you haven't sinned. Just because God hasn't destroyed you yet, that doesn't mean you haven't sinned.
And what harm hath happened unto me? And don't test God, talking about, well, what harm has come unto me?
For the Lord is longsuffering, he will in no wise let thee go.

note.label: Just Do The Work Your Wasting Time

points: Concerning propitiation. That's not a regular black word. So IT, if you would, please give us that definition of propitiation.

So concerning pacifying God's wrath, it says, be not without fear to add sin unto sin. In other words, you should be very fearful of sinning, breaking God's laws, because you're adding sin upon sin every time you break his laws. And again, it says in no wise will he let you go. There will be an answer for us breaking his laws.

note.label: Just Do The Work Your Wasting Time

points: And say not his mercy is great. That's what they say in these Sunday churches. Oh, the Lord is full of mercy and grace. Every time you ask them about repentance, or every time you ask them about keeping God's laws — oh, we ain't got to do that, we're under grace, we ain't under law, we're under grace. Biggest lie there is on the face of the planet. So many people deceived behind that.
For mercy and wrath come from him. Mercy and wrath come from God.
And his indignation resteth upon sinners. And his fierce anger resteth upon sinners. Those that are breaking God's laws, you're going to feel the wrath of God. That's basically what they're saying.

note.label: Just Do The Work Your Wasting Time

points: So understand again, time is short. Make no tarrying means don't delay to what? Turn to the Lord, to start keeping his commandments.

And put not off from day to day. And don't say, oh, I'll do it tomorrow. Oh, you know what, I'm going to repent tomorrow. I'm going to smoke this weed today, but I'm going to repent tomorrow. I'm going to go to the school and learn on the Sabbath. You might not make it to the Sabbath.

And in thy security thou shalt be destroyed. And in your securities, God will destroy you. Meaning when you're comfortable, thinking that you are safe and that nothing can touch you, where you find your comforts at, that's when God's going to show up. You're going to get your wake-up call.

note.label: Just Do The Work Your Wasting Time

points: “Follow not thine own mind and thy strength, to walk in the ways of thy heart.” When you find yourself veering off into your sins, you start to follow your own mind, to do what you want to do, to walk in your own opinions, thoughts and emotions.

“And say not, Who shall controul me for my works?” Don’t say, who will tell me what to do, I’m not listening to any leaders, I’ll eat what I want, sleep with who I want, when I want. A brother walked in the other day and said he wasn’t coming back, it’s too hard, he’s tired. Tired after seven or eight years? There are men here who have been in this truth almost thirty years. Satan says to you, only you are tired, they don’t understand you, you’ve been alone eight or nine years with no woman and no warmth at home. I understand you. Come, let’s go out in the world where things are easier; you can have who you want, how many you want. America is going to be destroyed and we all die anyway, so go out with a bang. Take that purple off. They call you lazy and immature; I love you, no one loves you more than me. Look at her now: she can kill babies when she wants to; look what I gave her.
“For the Lord will surely revenge thy pride.” You are going to get it.

“Say not, I have sinned, and what harm hath happened unto me?” That is Satan in your head: you fornicated, you had two women last week, and you’re still here, your heart is still beating. That Bible is up to interpretation, they are a cult, I’m God, I’m talking to you now, you’re spiritual.

“For the Lord is longsuffering, he will in no wise let thee go.” You are not dead because God is patient with his chosen. He says, Satan, you can have him a little while, but I want him back. Some go out like the prodigal son and come back, but they don’t come back unscathed: they come back with child support, with a disease, from jail. And some God does not want back at all. You don’t want that.

“Concerning propitiation”: that is reconciliation, returning to God. “Be not without fear to add sin unto sin.” Don’t think that because you got away with it you can do it again and again. We play with sin the way a child keeps touching what his father told him to leave alone. After a while the Most High visits you: he lets Satan send his messengers, makes you see things, lets anger hop in you so you hit your wife or lose your job. Short-term decisions lead to long-term consequences, because you kept poking the bear.

“And say not His mercy is great; he will be pacified for the multitude of my sins.” That is Christianity: grace, grace, I’m delivered, I’m saved, I can do what I want. “For mercy and wrath come from him, and his indignation resteth upon sinners.” He is coming for you.

“Make no tarrying to turn to the Lord, and put not off from day to day.” If you fell away, return, and sooner rather than later. Some are sitting at home playing in their sin so they won’t come to the school, saying I’m spiritual by myself in front of my computer or the television. That is not biblical; that is Satan. You are watching the news, seeing what Trump is doing and the chariots they call drones mobilizing, all that has been taught these past years coming to pass, and you are still dragging your feet.

“For suddenly shall the wrath of the Lord come forth, and in thy security thou shalt be destroyed, and perish in the day of vengeance.” Your security is your comfort and complacency. It will be too late.
